metadata.description: Agent skills for Uzbek payment provider APIs.

plugins.name: uzfintech
plugins.description: Uzum Bank, Alif, Click, Paynet, Payme, Multicard, Atmos, Octo, Oson and Kapitalbank API contracts, the BTS Express courier API, a cross-provider fiscal receipt skill, a Tasnif catalogue skill (MXIK search by name and barcode, package codes, re-checks, point-of-sale and VAT-payer checks), a router for choosing and comparing providers, schemas, anonymized examples, sandbox test data, lifecycle warnings, checklists, and signature / payload checking tools.
